name: Daily overdue inspection digest
status: Build specification; not an importable solution or active flow

actions.name: Get_inspections
actions.FilterQuery: Status ne 'Closed' and DueAt ne null and DueAt lt '@{outputs('RunTime')}'
actions.note: Index Status and DueAt. Large lists may need partitioned indexed views despite pagination.

actions.name: Send_digest
actions.subject: DEMO: overdue airport inspections @{outputs('TodayUTC')}
actions.body:
Synthetic demonstration requests. Review overdue items below.
@{body('Digest_table')}

action.Title: items('Mark_reminded')?['Title']
action.note: Only map required fields plus LastReminderDate; leave all other fields unmapped to avoid overwriting concurrent edits.

actions.name: Failure_scope
actions: Record error details in run history or a separate FlowErrors list
Terminate with Failed status; do not mark reminders complete

deliverySemantics: Best-effort once per UTC day for successful runs. A send succeeding followed by a failed stamp can cause a duplicate on rerun. Email has no exactly-once guarantee.
